review.reason: Adds a fallback execution path with explicit exception handling and tests that switch from exact HogQL counts to sampled-and-corrected versions when timeouts or memory limits occur. This is a substantive, bounded improvement in query resilience and cost control, not yet demonstrated as systemic across multiple critical paths.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's warehouse ingestion and managed warehouse connectors where expensive ClickHouse queries could otherwise cause transient outages or excessive resource consumption.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies only on this chunk; tier elevation requires seeing wider integration and production telemetry.
